evidence: The morphology of SnO2/TNTs as well as the Pd/SnO2/TNTs were characterized by SEM (JSM 6320F, JEOL) and TEM (JEM 3010, JEOL). The crystal structure of the SnO2 layers and the TiO2 substrates were analysed by XRD using a Rigaku RUh200 rotating anode X-ray generator... The chemical composition of the deposits was determined by XPS using a Kratos Axis Ultra DLD... The electrochemical characterizations of Pd/SnO2/TNTs were carried out in the conventional three-electrode electrochemical cell... The electroactivity of the Pd/SnO2/TNTs systems toward ethanol electrooxidation has been measured by cyclic voltammetry (CV) and chronoamperometry (CA).
